description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a loaded one-handed firearm.

A rapid-fire flourish trading accuracy for extra shots.

Make three Strikes against any number of targets within your first range increment, each at a −2 penalty. These Strikes count toward your multiple attack penalty as a single attack, and the weapon is emptied afterward regardless of how many shots hit.

cinderfall.incomplete: (Gunslinger's own multi-shot feats of this shape — Fake Out, Paired Shots — also rules: [], cited for shape confirmation only.). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP.
